UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Per-user workspace branding and non-PII configuration synchronized with Keystone Vault.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

systemName.description: Custom display name for the application header and title.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when workspace was last updated.

PublicAppDocument.title: PublicAppDocument
PublicAppDocument.description: Non-sensitive app launcher entry (logo, name, target URL, category) shown on the Home launcher.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the app owner.

id.description: Unique identifier of the app entry.

logo_type.description: Source type for the app icon or logo.

logo_value.description: Logo URL, preset key, or rasterized data URL.

target_url.description: Validated HTTP/HTTPS URL or deep link.

is_favorite.description: Whether the app is pinned as favorite.

lastUsedAt.description: Optional epoch milliseconds when app was last launched.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was updated.

EncryptedVaultDocument.title: EncryptedVaultDocument
EncryptedVaultDocument.description: Zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM encrypted vault envelope with PBKDF2-SHA256 admin key slots.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the vault owner.

keySlots.description: Bounded list (1-20) of per-admin wrapped DEK slots.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Client-recorded epoch ms of last encryption.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when vault was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when vault was updated.

AdminRegistration.title: AdminRegistration
AdminRegistration.description: Explicitly authorized cloud admin account record managed by the bootstrapped super admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID granted admin role.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was updated.

DeviceSession.title: DeviceSession
DeviceSession.description: Registered browser/device participating in real-time Firestore cloud sync.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

deviceName.description: Short non-PII device and browser label.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device first connected.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when device last synced.

/users/{userId}/publicApps/{appId}.description: Public launcher app metadata per user (without credentials).

/users/{userId}/vaultData/{vaultId}.description: Zero-knowledge encrypted credential vault envelope per user.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Connected devices synced in real time for the user.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Cloud-level admin allowlist managed exclusively by the bootstrapped admin.
